# Import checklist

**3 folders · 21 markups · 3 imports**

Before you start:
- onX **Premium or Elite** is required to import.
- Use the **Web Map** at webmap.onxmaps.com on a computer.
- Each numbered step is ONE import. Drag in **all** the files for that step together.

### 1. 3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler  (11 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **3_Course_Segments_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### 2. 2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler  (9 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **2_Aid_Stations_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Waypoints.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### 3. 1 - Course GPX Dark Divide 100 Miler  (1 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **1_Course_GPX_Dark_Divide_100_Miler_Tracks.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `1 - Course GPX Dark Divide 100 Miler`

### Renamed for onX

These names had `! @ # $ % ^ * &` removed. Search onX for the new name.

- `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS #1 to Sunrise Peak AS` → `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS 1 to Sunrise Peak AS`  (3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler)
- `[r1i1] 03 - Sunrise Peak AS #1 to Dark Creek AS` → `[r1i1] 03 - Sunrise Peak AS 1 to Dark Creek AS`  (3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler)
- `[r1i1] 09 - Summit Prairie AS to Sunrise Peak #2 AS` → `[r1i1] 09 - Summit Prairie AS to Sunrise Peak 2 AS`  (3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler)
- `[r1i1] 10 - Sunrise Peak #2 AS to Juniper Ridge #2 AS` → `[r1i1] 10 - Sunrise Peak 2 AS to Juniper Ridge 2 AS`  (3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler)
- `[r1i1] 11 - Juniper Ridge #2 AS to Cispus Learning Center (FINISH)` → `[r1i1] 11 - Juniper Ridge 2 AS to Cispus Learning Center (FINISH)`  (3 - Course Segments Dark Divide 100 Miler)

### Notes longer than onX keeps on import (512 characters)

onX cut a longer imported note to 512 characters, and dropped a much longer one entirely. Shorten these, or paste the rest into onX after import.

- `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS (Used Twice)`: 617 characters  (2 - Aid Stations Dark Divide 100 Miler)

---

When finished, My Content should show **3 folders** and **21 markups**.

If a folder is missing items, delete that folder and redo just its step.
